race.description: Attwood Marshall Lawyers Racing & Equine Law Hcp (C1)
race.comment: FLOP SHOT (6) gets the nod after just missing by that exact margin when launching home at the Sunny Coast last time. The rise to 1800m suits him perfectly third-up and he looms the one to beat. MADAME CODY (3) appeals as the main danger back from a CL2 at Doomben. The 3kg claim helps her settle into a suitable CL1 and the low draw should give her a good look. READY TO DRINK (10) has been leaving herself with too much to do but warming late. Stripping fitter fourth-up, if Osmond can settle he closer she can play a more significant role this time. ARGENTUM ROCK (2) is proven over the track and trip and his closing third in a CL2 here last week gives him a sound place platform despite being unwanted in betting. SEA WARNING (8) was much better last time when stretching to this tip and should be further improved.
